channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: US in ‘denuclearisation’ talks with Russia and China: Trump
item.description: US and Russia each have more than 4,000 warheads. China set to catch up with them within five years, Trump says.

item.title: Poland scrambles fighter jets as Russia strikes western Ukraine
item.description: Countries along NATO’s eastern flank growing increasingly concerned about the risk of escalation of the war in Ukraine.

item.title: Trump rules out using a nuclear bomb on Iran: Why that matters
item.description: It is the first time the president has addressed nuclear weapons, but he didn't deny US could use 'mother of all bombs'.

item.title: Asian Cup in Saudi Arabia still on, organisers say, but golf tour postponed
item.description: Asian Cup preparations continue for January, but Asian Tour delays golf's Saudi Invitational after Houthi attacks.

item.title: Norway wealth fund urged to ease nuclear arms ban after Gaza investment row
item.description: The review called for Norway's sovereign wealth fund to lift ethical risk limitations on its investments.

item.title: Alone in Gaza: Genocide leaves Palestinian man without family or a home
item.description: One man wanders Gaza in search of somewhere to sleep, having lost his family in an Israeli strike.

item.title: US sanctions leave Iranians facing flight cancellations and soaring costs
item.description: New US aviation sanctions force Iranians to take longer, costlier journeys as international flight routes disappear.

item.title: Rubio presses Lebanon on confiscation of weapons from Hezbollah
item.description: Lebanon's president reaffirms the commitment to bring all arms under state control.

item.title: Four killed as Indonesia battles worst forest fires in more than a decade
item.description: The deaths come as Jakarta says it will accept foreign help to tackle its worst forest fires in more than a decade.

item.title: Children aged 5, 8 and 11 killed in US school shooting before suspect shot by bystander
item.description: A teacher was also killed in the attack at the Silver Rail Elementary School in the city of Bend, Oregon, police say.
